title: DNMT3L Neuron: code for DNMT3L-sensitive methylation in Down syndrome neurodevelopment
description: Analysis code for the study of context-dependent concordance of DNMT3L-sensitive methylation in Down syndrome neurodevelopment. Version 1.1.0 adds conditional human CpG concordance, the shared-CpG mouse comparison, gene-level candidate scoring and sensitivity analyses, and figure reproduction.
